description: A peer that answers our ARQ data twice with WARNING reason 1 has no connection with us: the DTS declares the connection lost and rejects the C_PDU in flight, the link is broken locally, and the next U_PDU makes a new link.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ at 0. Link setup as cas/make-called-accept: the peer's PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST (Ed4) at 2000, our PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED out at 52000, and the link made when that transmission ends at 57550 (B-0213, B-0400): link_state linked and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 (B-0215). The peer is recorded Ed4 (B-0408) and the 16-bit family is in force. cas.first_data_timeout_ms is not set, so the first-data wait is the derived three answer waits, 180000 (B-0420). At 58000 conn 1 sends an ARQ U_PDU 'ping' to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3 (TTL 0); the soft link exists, so it goes down at once and dts.ttd runs to its TTD. The MAC follows its own transmission with the VDCD LBT wait (K-0074), 3000, then 12000 ms of contention; at 73000 the DATA-ONLY (FSN 0, 29 bytes, 2 blocks, EOT 20) goes out, then a PADDING D_PDU (11 bytes, EOT 10) in the spare bytes of its last block. dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts at 83350 (C-1120). At 91000 the peer answers with a WARNING (type 15, EOT 10) naming type 9, reason 1: it holds no connection with us (C-0578, C-0734). One alone is not enough (C-1251). At 143350 dts.ack_wait expires, the first unanswered wait in a row (C-1250), and FSN 0 is retransmitted: the burst heard was addressed to us alone, so LBT rule 1 gives no LBT wait (K-0067) and contention is 45000 ms; out at 188350, done at 198700, dts.ack_wait again. At 206000 a second WARNING reason 1 with no answer from the peer between: the link is half open (C-1251). The DTS sends D_CONNECTION_LOST to the CAS, then ends the connection itself (C-0739, C-1252): dts.ack_wait stops, the unconfirmed C_PDU is rejected with a local reason (C-0866), and dts.ttd, with nothing left, is cancelled. The CAS breaks the link locally with no C_PDU to the peer (B-0277, B-0324): cas.first_data stops, link_state unlinked, C_PHYSICAL_LINK_BROKEN to the SIS, which ends the soft link (A-0199). At 230000 conn 1 sends 'pong': there is no soft link, so the SIS holds it and asks for a new physical link (A-0193): link_state calling, and the PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST (Ed4) goes after LBT rule 1 and 36000 ms of contention, at 266000, our C_PDU ID 1; cas.link_request starts at 271550. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133). A CAS-1 C_PDU of one octet in a type 8 D_PDU fills a block exactly (25 bytes; EOT and reception window 10), C_PDU IDs from 0 in each node's own sequence (C-1040), EOW 0. DATA-ONLY 19 bytes plus segment; WARNING 15 bytes. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080).
